svg.title: A supplier bank change confirmed by a second person
svg.desc: A request comes from a finance officer, or from the supplier portal through an SPI. The account number is encrypted. A second person reveals it, then confirms or refuses through SodGuard. On confirmation the new account takes effect, the old one stays in the history, and the first payment within 30 days raises a signal.
